description: This file defines the EmployeeReportingMethodDao class, which handles database operations related to employee reporting structures such as saving reports, searching for supervisors and subordinates, and deleting reporting relationships within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class providing methods to manage employee reporting relationships, including CRUD operations, searches, and count retrievals as part of the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Persists a ReportTo entity representing a reporting relationship for an employee.

methods.name: searchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Searches for immediate supervisors of an employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Deletes supervisor relationships for a given subordinate employee ID and list of supervisor IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Deletes subordinate relationships for a given supervisor employee ID and list of subordinate IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Searches for subordinates of an employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportTo entity for a specific supervisor and subordinate employee pair.

methods.name: getExistingSubordinateIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing subordinate IDs for a supervisor, given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getExistingSupervisorIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing supervisor IDs for a subordinate, given a list of IDs.
